name: Raid Captain
shortDescription: The one the others keep looking at. She waits for three.
lookDescription: A tall badger in a patched greatcoat stands at the well with a pry-bar across her shoulders. The other raiders keep their eyes on her. She waits for three.
examineDescription: The Raid Captain is the one who decided the stores were worth the walk. Taller than the others, coat scorched at the cuffs, a pry-bar notched from doors. She does not rush one Collegian. She counts until three are locked, then she comes in hard. Alder would not send one Collegian for this.
lockNarration: The captain taps the pry-bar once on the well cover. The others go quiet.
victoryNarration: The Raid Captain drops the pry-bar, looks at the three of you, and decides the stores can wait for another night. She goes back out the way she came, and the yard feels larger.
